ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity cream/white pixels occupying approximately 75% of the visible surface, contrasted against a low-intensity black central region and peripheral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white zones on both lobes. Symmetrical black central pigment extending from the peduncle into the inner lobes. Sparse, small-scale black punctate dots distributed across the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-level vertex angle approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys, with increased jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lateral edges transitioning into a broadly concave trailing edge trajectory as it approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity circular patterns at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower quadrant of the left lobe and a single diagonal mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular borders at the fluke tips, consistent with historical tissue erosion or parasitic attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grained black speckling pattern distributed across the high-intensity ventral regions.
